# DropSpace v0.3.0-preview.7 — 3.0 completion hardening

<!-- update-summary: Preview.7 hardens DNS-SD, bilateral SAS pairing, explicit text/URL handoff, clipboard pause, bounded native previews, source-safe actions, encrypted-share framing, and revocation while keeping unconfigured deployment paths fail-closed. -->

Preview.7 is the completion-hardening Preview for the bounded 3.0 feature slice. It keeps DropSpace Windows-first and local-first, closes protocol and UI truth gaps, and preserves explicit consent at every network or clipboard boundary.

Official website: https://airanluo-dot.github.io/DropSpace/

## Protocol and privacy hardening

- DNS-SD now uses the standard mDNS multicast address `224.0.0.251:5353`. Announcements have no questions and four records (PTR, SRV, TXT, A); parsing is bounded, strict, private-IPv4-only, tolerant of unknown TXT keys, and deduplicated by stable `DeviceId`.
- DropLink pairing exposes the full bilateral lifecycle. Both devices must independently confirm the same SAS, transcript, and session before either side stores a peer secret. Rejection, expiry, cancellation, mismatch, and failed UI handling do not create trust.
- Text and URL handoff is an authenticated route separate from Clipboard History. Messages carry sender/session/kind/length/SHA-256/UTF-8/label/time metadata, enforce 1 MiB text and 32 KiB URL limits, preview before Accept/Reject, and commit only to Temporary Space without opening or changing the system clipboard.
- Clipboard Pause is persisted and acts as a commit barrier: local capture, remote envelope validation/import, automatic propagation, and remote system-clipboard writes stop with the `clipboard-paused` category.

## Preview, actions, and sharing

- PDF Quick Preview uses the Windows PDF renderer for bounded page rasterization, navigation, cancellation, corrupt-file fallback, and cache-after-success. Media preview uses a real non-autoplay `MediaPlayerElement` with transport controls and disposal.
- Quick Actions now expose source- and capability-checked IDs/providers for SHA-256, ZIP, QR, resize/convert, and metadata stripping. Image transforms always write new files and never overwrite the source.
- Internet Share uses an explicit cross-language wire contract: manifest `nonce | ciphertext | tag`, chunks `ciphertext | tag`, HKDF/AES-GCM vectors, URL-fragment key handling, and revoke-by-known-backend-origin/share ID. The reference Worker stores opaque ciphertext only.
- Nearby Share validates bounded item metadata and byte totals, preserves private-LAN-only behavior, emits hardened no-store responses, supports safe range reads, and retains expiry/revoke/no-listing limits.

## Validation boundary

The release workflow remains authoritative for .NET restore, Core/Infrastructure tests, WinUI build, portable EXE, installer lifecycle, MSIX, localization, smoke, checksums, update metadata, GitHub Release assets, and website/API synchronization. New policy tests cover handoff limits/integrity, mDNS packet contracts, bilateral SAS transcript ordering, and deterministic encrypted-share vectors.

This Preview is **CONDITIONAL** for the operational 3.0 gates: the repository includes the Worker source but no operator Cloudflare/R2 credentials or live backend, and this environment cannot provide two physical Windows 11 LAN devices for pairing, firewall, reconnect/resume, and browser-receiver evidence. Internet Share therefore remains unavailable unless an operator configures `DROPSPACE_SHARE_BACKEND_URL`; the release does not claim those external gates passed. Public Preview assets may be unsigned; verify `SHA256SUMS.txt` and expect SmartScreen on first run.

Native macOS/iOS/iPadOS/Android/Linux clients, accounts, WebRTC, AirDrop, Universal Clipboard, and cloud account sync remain out of scope.

## 中文说明

- Preview.7 完成 3.0 功能切片的协议与边界加固：标准 `224.0.0.251:5353` mDNS/DNS-SD 四记录通告、严格解析和按设备 ID 去重。
- DropLink 配对必须由两台设备分别确认相同的 SAS、转录和会话；拒绝、过期、取消、校验不匹配或界面异常都不会保存可信密钥。
- 文本/网址交接改用独立的认证消息通道，限制分别为 1 MiB 和 32 KiB，接收方预览后明确接受/拒绝，仅写入临时空间，不写入系统剪贴板，也不会自动打开网址。
- 剪贴板暂停状态持久化，并在本地捕获、远端导入、自动传播和系统剪贴板写入前形成提交屏障。
- PDF 使用 Windows 原生受限渲染和翻页，媒体预览不自动播放；图像操作不会覆盖源文件；互联网分享的清单/分块线序、加密向量和撤销路径已固定。
- 本版本对外发布结果为 **CONDITIONAL（有条件完成）**：仓库包含 Worker 源码但没有已部署的 Cloudflare/R2 后端和托管密钥，本环境也没有两台实体 Windows 11 设备完成局域网/浏览器验收。因此未将这些外部门禁伪报为通过。

Stable-channel users will not receive this Preview. Select the Preview channel only to test experimental builds.
